subject: JUDGE: review CLI hardening polish C1+C2 (self-learn-judge single-attempt)
description:
Skill-tagged judge. When the polish task's attempt completes, invoke self-learn-judge in SINGLE-ATTEMPT REVIEW MODE against its attempt branch. Fetch the diff via get_attempt_diff (it will show original fix + C1 + C2 vs main, since the branch merged in the approved attempt). Apply the code-review rubric.

Verify specifically:
- C1: checkSkills() now delegates to an extracted, exported link-strategy helper (symlink→junction→copy), and the NEW tests INJECT a throwing symlink fn so the junction AND copy fallback branches actually execute on this host (not just an inline re-implementation). Confirm the tests would fail if the fallback logic were broken — i.e. real coverage, not vacuous.
- C2: auto-heal protectedNames broadened to include the daemon's runtime-state files (agents.json, loops.json, op-cache.json, certs at minimum) alongside overlay/sessions/worktrees/workspace/token/node_modules.
- The 5 original invariants remain intact (no regression from the merge-in): no executable rm -rf, dirHasLiveData guard, resolveInstallDir, bin/install.js delegation.
- Run `node test/cli-init.test.js` yourself from the attempt worktree — must be exit 0, all green.

APPROVE (flat tier → HOLD for main; record ⏸ MERGE PENDING verdict, do NOT merge) if rubric + C1/C2 + invariants pass. Otherwise KICK BACK: set_status failed + wired record_decision with the concrete fixes. NEVER force-merge.
